source: Apple Guideline 2.1 Information Needed — New App Submission (2026-09-10), Task Contract #1889; guideline sub-points from the 1.2/5.1.2(i) rejection (2026-09-25, docs/IOS_APP_REVIEW_REJECTION_20260925.md), Task Contract #2136

scenes.name: Cold launch from the home screen with build visible (TestFlight card or Settings version/build)
Guest: catalog, article, map with loaded tiles, quest

Fresh install: email/Apple/Google/Facebook disabled until the Terms checkbox is checked; Terms show zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users; same on Registration before the account exists
Registration of a disposable account, activation, signed-in state
Sign-in with the permanent reviewer demo account
Favorites add/remove and personal trip plan visible in calendar
Report an author from the public profile menu; confirmation shown
Block an author; blocked state shown

Report every user-content type of another author — trip card, comment, direct message, trip chat message, quest review, photo: reason, send, confirmation that the report is reviewed within 24 hours (profile reports are ugc-report)
Block author X from a trip card: consequences dialog, confirm, X's card and comment disappear without reload, X listed in Settings → Privacy → Blocked users
iPad landscape: account menu has no cookie item; Privacy screen states the app does not track
Delete the disposable account; confirmation and failed re-login
Paid features, only if present in the candidate; otherwise notApplicable with evidence
Compatibility pass on the other supported device family
Sign-in and guest browse on an IPv6-only NAT64 Wi-Fi (IOS-16); nginx log shows the device's requests

guidelines.name: Terms (EULA) with zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users agreed before registration and every sign-in method
Method for filtering objectionable content
guidelines.attestation: Production word filter for comments, messages and trip chat plus pre-moderation of trips and quest reviews, active for the candidate's API: backend SHA and a dated production probe

guidelines.name: Mechanism to report offensive content, on every type of user content
Block abusive users: content leaves the blocker's feed instantly and the developer is notified
guidelines.attestation: Every block and report notifies the moderation team: backend SHA and a dated notification received for the recorded block

guidelines.name: Act on reports within 24 hours: remove content and eject the offending user
guidelines.attestation: Owner-confirmed moderation rota and admin actions remove-content and ban-user on production, with the date of confirmation

guidelines.name: Sign in with Apple offered next to the third-party login services
guidelines.attestation: ios:artifact:audit of the exact IPA lists com.apple.developer.applesignin in the signed entitlements

guidelines.name: Account deletion initiated inside the app
No tracking without ATT: no cookie prompts or cookie settings in the app
guidelines.attestation: ios:artifact:audit of the exact IPA shows NSPrivacyTracking=false and no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription; App Privacy in ASC declares Tracking = No
